content.short: D’CENT offers biometric and card hardware wallets.
content.description: D’CENT offers hardware and software wallet solutions that pair with a mobile app. The biometric wallet uses fingerprint authentication to protect private keys and includes a display for viewing transaction details and account balances. The card-type wallet relies on NFC to connect to the app, delivering quick access, though each card is configured for a single blockchain. Together, these options provide secure key storage on a hardware device while enabling management of assets across supported networks.
content.meta: D’CENT is a hardware and software wallet provider. Discover D’CENT and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
